text: Identify one qualification required to become a High Court judge. [1]
Identify two Acts of Parliament which provide the police with powers to stop and search. [2]
Describe the three classifications of criminal cases heard in the Magistrates’ Court. [6]
Describe two ways in which Parliament can control delegated legislation. [6]
Discuss the disadvantages of using a jury in the criminal justice system. [10]
